notRead: Mob drops coded in mod jars (Lycanites, OreSpawn, TragicMC, Legends, Twilight Forest, HEE, Witchery ...): only what the descriptions say.

Dungeon loot rolled in mod code (Roguelike Dungeons, Recurrent Complex, OreSpawn and TragicMC dungeons, Twilight Forest hollow hills and towers, Battle Towers): only ChestGenHooks tables and the pack's own loot configs were read.
Machine, altar, cauldron and other non-vanilla recipes (Witchery, Railcraft rolling machine, ProjectE transmutation, Psychedelicraft, Legends Suit Assembly): only what the descriptions say.
The 99 IRecipe objects whose getRecipeOutput() was null in the dump: the dump directory with their class names (unreadableTypes) is gone; only the count survives in recipes.json.
MobProperties (224 mob files) adds no custom drops in this pack (every 'drops' list is empty), and Lycanites' custom-drop config lines are all blank; both were read, neither adds a source.

Recipes a mod registers only once a world is open: the dump ran at the title screen, so Sync's core recipe (Sync.cfg hardcoreMode=2 decides it per world) is missing, and any other world-time registration with it.

Mods the dump saw no crafting recipe for at all, although they have items: ChocolateQuest (its weapons and staffs are shop and dungeon loot by design), Recurrent Complex (creative tools), and Transformers, which is the suspicious one: its jar's TFRecipes class calls GameRegistry.addRecipe, addShapelessRecipe and addSmelting, so vanilla recipes exist in the mod, yet the dump holds none (its RecipeClearConfig class suggests a config can clear them, or they were registered after the dump ran). Its 44 'no-source' items are a dump gap to re-check in-game, not dead items.
Mod jars were opened read-only for file listings only (Witchery's recipe class names, MCHeli's aircraft definitions); no class was decompiled.
configAnomalies: pack/config/Chocolate/ChestConfig/chests.prop: `potion= chocolateQuest:healingPotion 1,0,20` is malformed (a space where a comma should be), so this chest entry never rolls

pack/config/Chocolate/ChestConfig/treasures.prop: `rustedSwordAndShield = chocolateQuest:rustedSword,1,0,1` names an item that does not exist (chocolateQuest:rustedSword), so this chest entry never rolls

witchery:mirror.get: Made by the Rite of Infusion, trapping a Demon with Brew of Hollow Tears, a gold ingot and a glass pane.

witchery:mirrorblock.name: Mirror
witchery:mirrorblock.get: Technical block, not obtainable; place a Mirror.

witchery:mooncharm.name: Moon Charm
witchery:mooncharm.get: Given by the Wolf Altar to a werewolf who offers 3 gold ingots.

witchery:mutator.name: Mutating Sprig
witchery:mutator.get: Made by a Witch's Cauldron ritual from Mutandis Extremis, nether wart and an Ent Twig.

witchery:mysticbranch.name: Mystic Branch
witchery:mysticbranch.get: Made by the Rite of Infusion from an Ent Twig and Mystic Unguent, at night.

witchery:perpetualice.name: Perpetual Ice
witchery:perpetualice.get: Conjured by the Rite of the Ice Shell or a frost brew.

witchery:pitdirt.name: Dirt
witchery:pitdirt.get: Made by a Witch's Cauldron ritual started with Tormented Twine.

witchery:pitgrass.name: Grass
witchery:pitgrass.get: Made by a Witch's Cauldron ritual started with Tormented Twine.

witchery:playercompass.name: Player Compass
witchery:playercompass.get: Made by a Witch's Cauldron ritual started with a compass.

witchery:quiverofmog.name: Mog's Quiver
witchery:quiverofmog.get: Dropped by Mog, a hobgoblin god summoned at the Statue of Hobgoblin Patron.

witchery:rowanwooddoor.name: Rowan Wood Door
witchery:rowanwooddoor.get: Technical block, not obtainable; place the Rowan Wood Door item.

witchery:scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
witchery:scarecrow.get: Craft the blank; bind spirits to it with the Rite of Binding.

witchery:seedsmandrake.name: Mandrake Seeds
witchery:seedsmandrake.get: Tall grass sometimes yields them; also dropped by Mandrakes.

witchery:spanishmoss.name: Spanish Moss
witchery:spanishmoss.get: Mutate another plant into it with Mutandis.

witchery:spectralstone.name: Spectral Stone
witchery:spectralstone.get: Made by the Rite of Necromancy; filled by the Rite of Binding.

witchery:sungrenade.name: Sun Grenade
witchery:sungrenade.get: Made in a Sun Collector from a Quartz Sphere charged in daylight.

witchery:witchhand.name: Witches Hand
witchery:witchhand.get: Dropped by witches and coven witches killed by a player (more often with the Arthana).

witchery:witchleaves.name: Rowan Leaves
witchery:witchleaves.get: Grow from Rowan, Alder or Hawthorn saplings.

witchery:witchlog.name: Rowan Wood
witchery:witchlog.get: Grow from Rowan, Alder or Hawthorn saplings.

witchery:witchsapling.name: Rowan Sapling
witchery:witchsapling.get: Mutate a sapling with Mutandis; Ents also drop them.

witchery:witchwoodslab.name: Rowan Slab
witchery:witchwoodslab.get: Creative only; Witchery adds no recipe for them.

witchery:wolfhead.name: Wolf Head
witchery:wolfhead.get: Wolves killed by a player sometimes drop the wolf head; Hellhounds drop the hellhound head.

witchery:wormwood.name: Wormwood
witchery:wormwood.get: Mutate fully grown wheat surrounded by Wispy Cotton with a Mutating Sprig.
